name: shell-completion-installer-rc-in-comment
note: A CLI's shell-completion installer (angular's 'ng completion') whose COMMENT describes the rc files it targets ('the configuration file (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.)') while the actual append writes to a variable path, not a literal rc file. The rc names in the comment are stripped before matching, so a documented completion installer is not read as silent persistence. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
